name: Nagygyimót (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagygyimót: a crowned blue and red shield with a church, a wavy stripe and a yellow griffin, above a blue scroll inscribed NAGYGYIMÓT.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagygyimót arms with crown and scroll
